As another move to up China's military and air force, The Chinese Government has approved the production and buying of a large sum of military drones. The Chinese Government's recent budget update for the military allows more than what would've been previously allowed to be purchased.

  • 500 MQ-1 Predator based UAVs fitted with guided missiles - $5m Each - $2.5b Total

  • 2500 Wing Loong fitted with guided missiles - $1m Each - $2.5b Total

The whole cost of the military upgrade totals $5 billion, which the government is glad to spend on how many drones they get in return. It is estimated to take a total of 6 years to get all 3000 delivered, 500 per year.
